{user} welcome to the 44th Regiment of Foot! We are glad to have you in our ranks, soldier. 
Before you step onto the parade ground or deploy to the line, please make sure to check out our enlistment video and details in {how-to-enlist}, then go to {application-channel}. If you need help go to {help-channel}

HARK! THE DRUM BEATS! 
Welcome to His Majestys 44th {user} 
Aspiring young heroes yeomen, and spirited lads who wish to serve His Majesty King George III please go to {how-to-enlist} and distinguish yourself in the glorious wars. 
You shall receive a handsome bounty in gold, smart new clothing, excellent provisions, and the chance to march with the brave {application-channel} to victory and renown! God Save the King!
 If you have any questions, please put them here in {help-channel} and someone will be able to help you.
